Browser auto re-fetches SPA shell when JS rendering is detected

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import scrape, create_engine, CrawlConfig, BrowserConfig

async def main() -> None:
    engine_config = CrawlConfig(browser=BrowserConfig(mode="always"))
    engine = create_engine(engine_config)
    url = "https://example.com"
    result = await scrape(engine, url)
    print(result.js_render_hint)
    print(result.browser_used)

asyncio.run(main())
```
